words.enDefinition: an instrument that uses visible light and separate objective and viewing lenses to magnify small structures

examples.en: The diagram of a compound light microscope shows where light passes through the prepared teaching slide.
examples.zh: 「复式光学显微镜」的示意图显示了光线从哪里穿过已制好的教学玻片。

examples.en: The instructor used a compound light microscope to display the outline of a human skin section.
examples.zh: 老师用「复式光学显微镜」展示人体皮肤切片的轮廓。

collocations: parts of a compound light microscope
view a slide through a compound light microscope

words.enDefinition: the ability of an optical system to distinguish nearby features as separate details

examples.en: The simulated image lost optical resolution when the two fine features blended into a single mark.
examples.zh: 两个细小特征融合成一个斑点时，模拟图像的「光学分辨率」有所降低。

examples.en: We compared optical resolution using the finest pair of clearly separated lines on the supplied test image.
examples.zh: 我们用给出的测试图中间距最小且仍能清楚辨认的一对线比较「光学分辨率」。

words.enDefinition: the product of the contributing magnifications, commonly the objective and eyepiece powers in direct microscope viewing

examples.en: We calculated total magnification from the two powers printed on the classroom objective and eyepiece labels.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂物镜和目镜标签上印出的两个倍率计算「总放大倍数」。

examples.en: Two images had the same total magnification but showed different amounts of fine detail in the comparison.
examples.zh: 对照中，两幅图的「总放大倍数」相同，但显示的精细细节数量不同。

words.enDefinition: the lens assembly nearest the specimen that forms the microscope's primary magnified image

examples.en: The diagram shows the objective lens directly above the slide on the classroom microscope illustration.
examples.zh: 课堂显微镜图中，「物镜」位于玻片正上方。

examples.en: We read the power engraved on the objective lens before identifying the matching teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们先读出「物镜」上刻的倍率，再辨认相应的教学图像。

words.enDefinition: the part of an optical instrument through which a viewer looks, commonly magnifying an intermediate image

examples.en: The eyepiece is at the upper end of the viewing tube in the classroom microscope diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂显微镜图中，「目镜」位于观察镜筒的上端。

examples.en: The power printed on the eyepiece was one factor in the worksheet's total magnification calculation.
examples.zh: 「目镜」上印的倍率是练习中计算总放大倍数的一个因子。

words.enDefinition: the platform that holds a slide or other specimen in position beneath the objective

examples.en: The microscope stage supports the prepared slide below the objective in the labeled classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂标注图中，「显微镜载物台」在物镜下方托住已制好的玻片。

examples.en: We found the microscope stage by locating the platform with a central opening for transmitted light.
examples.zh: 我们在图中找到中央有透光开口的平台，从而辨认出「显微镜载物台」。

collocations: position a slide on the microscope stage

words.enDefinition: a microscope stage that moves a held slide in two horizontal directions using positioning controls

examples.en: The film shows the mechanical stage moving the slide sideways while the objective stays in place.
examples.zh: 影片显示，「机械载物台」使玻片横向移动，物镜则保持在原位。

examples.en: We identified the two positioning controls for the mechanical stage on the microscope's parts diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在显微镜部件图上找出「机械载物台」的两个定位控制件。

words.enDefinition: the rotating microscope part holding several objectives and bringing one at a time into the light path

examples.en: The revolving nosepiece holds three objective lenses in the labeled drawing of the classroom microscope.
examples.zh: 在课堂显微镜标注图上，「物镜转换器」装有三个物镜。

examples.en: We followed the circular arrow beside the revolving nosepiece to see how another objective enters the light path.
examples.zh: 我们沿「物镜转换器」旁的圆弧箭头，观察另一物镜如何进入光路。

words.enDefinition: a lens or lens assembly that directs illuminating light onto the specimen in a microscope

examples.en: The condenser lens sits below the specimen and directs light upward in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中，「聚光镜」位于标本下方，将光线引向上方。

examples.en: We traced the light path through the condenser lens before it reached the prepared section.
examples.zh: 光线还未到达已制好的切片时，我们在图中追踪其穿过「聚光镜」的路径。

collocations: light passing through a condenser lens

words.enDefinition: a microscope illumination control that limits the area of the specimen reached by the illuminating light

examples.en: The diagram labels the field diaphragm where the illustrated aperture limits the illuminated portion of the specimen.
examples.zh: 图中在所绘开口限制标本受照范围的位置标出「视场光阑」。

examples.en: We distinguished the field diaphragm from the aperture that controls the angle of the illuminating cone.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「视场光阑」和控制照明光锥角度的那个光阑。

collocations: field diaphragm in the illumination path

words.enDefinition: a control in the illumination path that limits the angles of the light reaching a microscope specimen

examples.en: The aperture diaphragm narrows the light cone drawn beneath the slide in the classroom optics diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂光学图中的「孔径光阑」使玻片下方所绘的光锥变窄。

examples.en: We labeled the aperture diaphragm near the condenser in the illustrated transmitted-light microscope assembly.
examples.zh: 我们在透射光显微镜组件图中，在聚光镜附近标出了「孔径光阑」。

collocations: light cone limited by the aperture diaphragm

words.enDefinition: the microscope control that produces relatively large movements to bring the image toward focus

examples.en: The coarse focus knob is drawn as the larger control on the side of the classroom microscope.
examples.zh: 课堂显微镜侧面的较大控制件标为「粗调焦旋钮」。

examples.en: We compared the movements associated with the coarse focus knob and the fine control in the animation.
examples.zh: 我们在动画中比较了「粗调焦旋钮」和微调控制件所产生的移动。

collocations: movement from the coarse focus knob

words.enDefinition: the microscope control that makes small changes to the relative position of the lens and specimen for precise focusing

examples.en: The animation links the fine focus knob to a small movement and a sharper image of the section.
examples.zh: 动画将「微调焦旋钮」与微小位移及更清晰的切片图像联系起来。

examples.en: We identified the fine focus knob inside the larger focus control on the microscope illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在显微镜图中较大调焦控制件的内侧找到了「微调焦旋钮」。

collocations: short movement of the fine focus knob

words.enDefinition: the distance from the front of a microscope objective to the cover glass or specimen surface at focus

examples.en: We compared working distance between two objective lenses using the spacing shown in their specification drawings.
examples.zh: 我们用两个物镜规格图中所示的间距来比较各自的「工作距离」。

examples.en: The working distance is marked as the gap immediately below the objective in the focused model.
examples.zh: 对好焦的模型中，紧靠物镜正下方的间距标为「工作距离」。

words.enDefinition: a dimensionless quantity equal to the refractive index on the specimen side times the sine of the accepted light cone's half-angle

examples.en: The objective with the larger numerical aperture collects light over a wider angle in the model immersion medium.
examples.zh: 在同一种模拟浸液中，「数值孔径」较大的物镜能收集角度范围更宽的光。

examples.en: We read the numerical aperture beside the magnification on the diagram of an objective barrel in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在物镜镜筒示意图所标的放大倍率旁读出了「数值孔径」。

words.enDefinition: in specimen viewing, the plane through the specimen that appears sharp at the current focus setting

examples.en: The simulated focal plane passed through the top of the tissue fold, bringing that layer into focus.
examples.zh: 模拟「焦平面」穿过组织褶皱顶部，使该层清楚成像。

examples.en: We compared the features visible in the two positions of the focal plane on the digital example.
examples.zh: 我们在数字示例中比较「焦平面」处于两个位置时分别可见的特征。

words.enDefinition: the area visible through an optical instrument or within a displayed image at a given setting

examples.en: The small gland occupied most of the field of view after the instructor changed to higher magnification.
examples.zh: 老师切换到较高倍率后，小腺体占据了大部分「视野范围」。

examples.en: We marked the edge of the field of view on the circular microscope image in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们在圆形显微图像上标出了「视野范围」的边缘。

collocations: structures within the field of view

words.enDefinition: microscopy in which transmitted light gives a bright background against which absorbing structures appear darker

examples.en: The example uses brightfield microscopy to show a stained tissue section against a light background.
examples.zh: 该示例用「明场显微术」在明亮背景上呈现染色组织切片。

examples.en: We identified brightfield microscopy from the bright open regions surrounding the darker structures in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们依据教学图中围绕较暗结构的明亮空白区域，辨认出「明场显微术」。

words.enDefinition: microscopy that excludes direct illumination from the image so scattered light shows objects on a dark background

examples.en: The example of darkfield microscopy shows bright boundaries against a nearly black background in the optics handout.
examples.zh: 光学讲义中「暗场显微术」的示例显示，明亮边界衬在近黑色背景上。

examples.en: We compared darkfield microscopy and brightfield images of the same classroom test pattern in the tutorial.
examples.zh: 我们在教程中比较同一课堂测试图案的「暗场显微术」图像和明场图像。

words.enDefinition: microscopy that converts optical phase shifts introduced by transparent structures into visible variations in brightness

examples.en: The teaching image uses phase-contrast microscopy to make the outline of transparent structures easier to distinguish.
examples.zh: 教学图用「相差显微术」使透明结构的轮廓更容易辨认。

examples.en: We compared a brightfield view of the same unstained model with its phase-contrast microscopy image in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将同一未染色模型的明场图与其「相差显微术」图像作比较。

words.enDefinition: microscopy that forms an image from light emitted by fluorescent material after optical excitation

examples.en: The fluorescence microscopy example shows bright labeled structures on a dark background in the supplied atlas.
examples.zh: 给定图谱中的「荧光显微术」示例显示，带标记的明亮结构位于暗背景中。

examples.en: The class compared two fluorescence microscopy images to identify which parts of the teaching section emitted light.
examples.zh: 全班比较两幅「荧光显微术」图像，辨认教学切片中的哪些部位发光。

words.enDefinition: optical microscopy that rejects much of the out-of-focus light to improve imaging of a selected depth

examples.en: The confocal microscopy image showed a single depth within the thick educational specimen more clearly.
examples.zh: 「共聚焦显微术」图像使较厚教学标本内某一深度的结构显示得更清楚。

examples.en: We compared confocal microscopy with conventional imaging using the provided drawings of in-focus and out-of-focus rays.
examples.zh: 我们用给出的合焦和离焦光线图，对照「共聚焦显微术」与普通成像。

words.enDefinition: microscopy using polarized illumination to reveal how materials alter the polarization of light

examples.en: The comparison uses polarized light microscopy to reveal bright bands in the classroom fiber image.
examples.zh: 对照示例用「偏振光显微术」显示课堂用纤维图像中的明亮条带。

examples.en: We read the caption to identify why the polarized light microscopy image differed from the brightfield view.
examples.zh: 我们阅读图注，了解「偏振光显微术」图像与明场图像为何不同。

words.enDefinition: an image formed from electrons passing through a thin specimen in a transmission electron microscope

examples.en: The transmission electron micrograph shows internal features of the cell in the high-resolution classroom atlas.
examples.zh: 高分辨率课堂图谱中的「透射电子显微图」显示细胞内部结构。

examples.en: We used the scale bar to compare membrane thicknesses on the supplied transmission electron micrograph.
examples.zh: 我们用比例尺比较给出的「透射电子显微图」上几处膜的厚度。

collocations: transmission electron micrograph of a thin section
scale bar on a transmission electron micrograph

words.enDefinition: an image made from signals generated as a focused electron beam scans the specimen's surface

examples.en: The scanning electron micrograph reveals ridges on the surface rather than internal layers of the pictured tissue.
examples.zh: 「扫描电子显微图」呈现所示组织表面的隆起，可与内部各层图像区分。

examples.en: We compared surface textures in the scanning electron micrograph using the labeled regions in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们依据图谱中标出的区域，对照了「扫描电子显微图」中的表面纹理。

collocations: scanning electron micrograph of a surface
scale bar on a scanning electron micrograph

words.enDefinition: a microscope view at relatively low magnification, useful for seeing overall layout over a wider area

examples.en: The low-power view showed the whole skin section before the class examined a much smaller region.
examples.zh: 全班查看更小区域之前，先用「低倍视图」看到完整的皮肤切片。

examples.en: We used the low-power view to find where the epidermis met the edge of the pictured section.
examples.zh: 我们用「低倍视图」寻找表皮与所示切片边缘相交的位置。

collocations: choose a region on the low-power view

words.enDefinition: the area visible through a microscope with a high-power objective under specified optics

examples.en: The high-power field shows a small part of the gland, with individual nuclei visible in the classroom image.
examples.zh: 课堂图像的「高倍视野」只覆盖腺体的一小部分，可见各个细胞核。

examples.en: We compared what fit inside the high-power field with the whole section shown on the adjacent page.
examples.zh: 我们把「高倍视野」内可见的部分与相邻页面显示的完整切片对照。

words.enDefinition: a thin transparent piece placed over a microscope specimen on a slide

examples.en: The drawing shows a cover slip as a thin transparent layer directly above the prepared tissue section.
examples.zh: 图中，「盖玻片」是紧贴已制好组织切片上方的一层薄的透明材料。

examples.en: We distinguished the cover slip from the thicker slide supporting the section in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「盖玻片」与图中承托切片的较厚载玻片。

words.enDefinition: a flat transparent support on which a specimen is held for microscopic viewing

examples.en: The microscope slide is the rectangular glass support under the small specimen in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂图上，「载玻片」是小标本下方的矩形玻璃托片。

examples.en: We read the printed label attached to the microscope slide before matching it to a teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们阅读贴在「载玻片」上的印刷标签，然后将它与教学图像相匹配。

words.enDefinition: a slide bearing a specimen already mounted for viewing, often preserved as a teaching reference

examples.en: The prepared slide was labeled as normal skin in the classroom collection shown on the course page.
examples.zh: 课程页展示的课堂玻片集中，「已制标本玻片」标注为正常皮肤。

examples.en: We matched the reference image with the prepared slide listed under the same tissue name.
examples.zh: 我们把参考图像与列在同一组织名称下的「已制标本玻片」对应起来。

words.enDefinition: a specimen enclosed and sealed for long-term storage and repeated microscopic examination

examples.en: The atlas identifies the reference section as a permanent mount intended for repeated classroom observations.
examples.zh: 图谱将该参考切片标为供课堂反复观察的「永久封片」。

examples.en: We compared the listed age of the permanent mount with the date on its storage label.
examples.zh: 我们将「永久封片」列出的存放年限与保管标签上的日期作比较。

collocations: permanent mount of a tissue section

words.enDefinition: a small overview image of a digitized microscope slide used to locate a magnified region

examples.en: The slide thumbnail marked the current viewing area with a rectangle on the small overview image.
examples.zh: 「切片缩略图」在缩小的全图上用一个矩形标出当前查看的区域。

examples.en: We selected a new corner of the tissue on the slide thumbnail during the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习时，我们在「切片缩略图」上选择组织的另一个角落。

collocations: current position on the slide thumbnail
select a region on the slide thumbnail

words.enDefinition: a high-resolution digital scan covering the tissue on a microscope slide as a continuous view

examples.en: The whole-slide image includes the entire tissue outline and permits magnification of the marked corner.
examples.zh: 「全切片图像」包括完整的组织轮廓，并可放大标出的角落。

examples.en: We opened the whole-slide image to see how the cropped field fit within the rest of the section.
examples.zh: 我们打开「全切片图像」，查看裁出的局部在整张切片中的位置。

words.enDefinition: software used to navigate, magnify and inspect a digitized microscope slide

examples.en: The digital slide viewer places a small overview map beside the enlarged tissue region in the classroom demo.
examples.zh: 课堂演示中，「数字切片查看器」在放大的组织区域旁显示一张缩小的全图。

examples.en: We compared two regions using the position boxes shown in the digital slide viewer during class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「数字切片查看器」中显示的定位框，比较两个区域。

collocations: navigate with a digital slide viewer

words.enDefinition: the direction of a tissue sample or section relative to its normal anatomical surfaces and axes

examples.en: We determined tissue orientation by locating the outer surface and deeper structures in the classroom skin section.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂用皮肤切片中找到外表面与较深结构，借此确定「组织取向」。

examples.en: The instructor added arrows to indicate tissue orientation on the paired teaching images in the atlas.
examples.zh: 老师在图谱中成对的教学图上加了箭头，用来表示「组织取向」。

words.enDefinition: one of a sequence of thin slices taken from neighboring levels of the same specimen

examples.en: The atlas shows each serial section in order so students can follow the shape through the tissue.
examples.zh: 图谱按顺序显示每张「连续切片」，让学生能沿着组织观察结构形状的变化。

examples.en: We compared a serial section with the next image to see where the lumen first appeared.
examples.zh: 我们对照一张「连续切片」与下一张图，观察管腔首次出现的位置。

collocations: compare a serial section with its neighbor

words.enDefinition: a thin tissue slice obtained from a specimen supported by paraffin wax during sectioning

examples.en: The classroom atlas identifies the skin specimen as a paraffin section in its explanatory caption.
examples.zh: 课堂图谱在说明图注中将这份皮肤标本标为「石蜡切片」。

examples.en: We read the label on the paraffin section before comparing it with the nearby reference drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先读「石蜡切片」标签，再与邻近的参考图作比较。

words.enDefinition: a thin slice cut from tissue that was frozen to give it support during sectioning

examples.en: The slide description names a frozen section as the source of the image on the left.
examples.zh: 玻片说明将左侧图像的来源标为「冰冻切片」。

examples.en: We compared the frozen section and the wax-supported section using the images supplied by the instructor.
examples.zh: 我们使用老师给出的图像，对照「冰冻切片」与石蜡支撑的切片。

words.enDefinition: a thin tissue slice that has not been given color by adding a histological stain

examples.en: The supplied unstained section image had little contrast between the neighboring transparent structures in the tissue.
examples.zh: 给出的「未染色切片」图像中，组织内相邻透明结构之间的反差很小。

examples.en: We used the unstained section as a visual comparison beside the colored image in the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们把「未染色切片」放在图谱的着色图旁作为视觉参照。

collocations: compare an unstained section with a stained section

words.enDefinition: a dye or reagent used to make tissue structures distinguishable in a microscopic specimen

examples.en: The instructor named the histological stain used to make the nuclei visible in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 老师指出，在这幅教学图中用来显出细胞核的「组织学染料」是哪一种。

examples.en: We compared two sections whose captions identified a different histological stain for each pictured tissue.
examples.zh: 我们比较两份切片，其图注分别标出了各自使用的「组织学染料」。

collocations: color produced by a histological stain

words.enDefinition: a common histology stain combination in which nuclear structures usually appear blue to purple and much cytoplasm appears pink

examples.en: The hematoxylin and eosin stain made most nuclei purple and the surrounding cytoplasm pink in the reference image.
examples.zh: 参考图中的「苏木精–伊红染色」使大多数细胞核呈紫色，周围细胞质呈粉色。

examples.en: We recognized the hematoxylin and eosin stain from the description below the normal skin section in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据正常皮肤切片下方的说明辨认出「苏木精–伊红染色」。

collocations: identify a hematoxylin and eosin stain
section with a hematoxylin and eosin stain

words.enDefinition: a histological staining component that commonly gives nuclei a blue or purple color in prepared sections

examples.en: The atlas explains that hematoxylin gives the dark blue nuclear structures their color in this section.
examples.zh: 图谱解释，在这份切片中，是「苏木精」使细胞核结构着深蓝色。

examples.en: We pointed out areas colored by hematoxylin before describing the pink regions around them in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先指出受「苏木精」着色的区域，再描述周围的粉色区域。

words.enDefinition: a pink to red stain that colors many cytoplasmic proteins and extracellular structures in tissue sections

examples.en: The caption attributes the pink color of many fibers in the reference section to eosin staining.
examples.zh: 图注指出，参考切片中许多纤维的粉色来自「伊红」染色。

examples.en: We compared the pale pink and stronger pink regions associated with eosin in the classroom histology image.
examples.zh: 我们对照课堂组织学图中与「伊红」相关的浅粉色和较深粉色区域。

words.enDefinition: staining of tissue components with affinity for basic dyes, often associated with nucleic acid-rich structures

examples.en: The basophilic staining was most prominent in the dark nuclei of the cells shown in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 在教学图所示细胞中，深色细胞核的「嗜碱性着色」最明显。

examples.en: We marked basophilic staining separately from the pink regions in our description of the section.
examples.zh: 我们在切片描述中将「嗜碱性着色」与粉色区域分别标记。

words.enDefinition: pink to red staining caused by affinity of proteins or other tissue components for eosin

examples.en: The reference image shows eosinophilic staining in the pink fibers between the darker nuclei of the tissue.
examples.zh: 在参考图的组织中，深色细胞核间的粉红色纤维显示了「嗜伊红性着色」。

examples.en: We labeled the stronger eosinophilic staining where the teaching section showed particularly bright pink material.
examples.zh: 教学切片显示鲜明粉红色物质处，我们标注了更强的「嗜伊红性着色」。

words.enDefinition: an additional stain that gives contrasting color to structures that are less visible with the primary stain

examples.en: The counterstain colored surrounding structures pink in the example, making the blue nuclei easier to distinguish.
examples.zh: 示例中的「复染剂」将周围结构染成粉色，使蓝色细胞核更容易分辨。

examples.en: We read the caption to identify the counterstain responsible for the lighter background color in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们阅读图注，辨认产生较浅背景颜色的「复染剂」。

words.enDefinition: a histological stain that can highlight certain carbohydrate-rich tissue structures in magenta

examples.en: The periodic acid-Schiff stain highlighted the basement membrane in magenta on the prepared reference image.
examples.zh: 在已制好的参考图像上，「过碘酸–希夫染色」使基底膜呈品红色。

examples.en: We noted the colored border on the periodic acid-Schiff stain example during the slide reading exercise.
examples.zh: 在切片读图练习中，我们留意到「过碘酸–希夫染色」示例上的着色边界。

words.enDefinition: a group of staining approaches using three dyes to distinguish tissue components, often muscle from collagen

examples.en: The teaching caption identifies a trichrome stain that colors muscle and collagen differently in the example section.
examples.zh: 教学图注指出，示例切片使用「三色染色」，使肌肉和胶原呈不同颜色。

examples.en: We traced the boundary between two colors on the trichrome stain image from the atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在图谱的「三色染色」图像上，沿两种颜色之间的边界追踪。

collocations: collagen highlighted by a trichrome stain

words.enDefinition: the visible strength of staining in a specified tissue region under stated imaging conditions

examples.en: The staining intensity was greater in the nucleus than in the surrounding area of the reference cells.
examples.zh: 在参考细胞中，细胞核的「染色强度」大于周边区域。

examples.en: We compared staining intensity only between prepared sections with matched staining and imaging conditions.
examples.zh: 我们只在染色和成像条件一致的已制切片之间比较「染色强度」。

words.enDefinition: the spatial arrangement of cells, supporting structures and other components within a tissue

examples.en: The low-power image showed the tissue architecture of the gland before we examined individual cells in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，在辨认各细胞之前，我们先通过低倍图像观察腺体的「组织构筑」。

examples.en: We described tissue architecture by noting the arrangement of ducts and the surrounding supporting tissue in the image.
examples.zh: 我们记录图中的导管与周围支持组织的排列，用以描述「组织构筑」。

words.enDefinition: the shape, size and structural appearance of a cell as seen in an image or specimen

examples.en: We described cellular morphology in the exercise by comparing flattened cells with the taller neighboring cells.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们比较扁平细胞和邻近的较高细胞，用以描述「细胞形态」。

examples.en: The atlas uses paired drawings to show how cellular morphology changes across layers of the normal tissue.
examples.zh: 图谱用成对的图展示在正常组织不同层中「细胞形态」的变化。

words.enDefinition: the size, shape and structural appearance of a cell nucleus

examples.en: We recorded nuclear morphology by noting whether the visible nuclei were round or elongated in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们通过记录可见细胞核呈圆形还是长形来描述「细胞核形态」。

examples.en: The supplied teaching images show contrasting nuclear morphology in two different normal cell types from the atlas.
examples.zh: 给出的教学图显示，图谱中两种不同正常细胞的「细胞核形态」各异。

words.enDefinition: the open space inside a tube, blood vessel or other hollow anatomical structure

examples.en: The lumen is the central open space surrounded by cells in the prepared section of the duct.
examples.zh: 在已制好的导管切片中，「管腔」是被细胞包围的中央空隙。

examples.en: We traced the edge of the lumen before labeling the tissue lining it in the drawing.
examples.zh: 我们先沿「管腔」边缘描线，再在图中标出覆盖它的组织。

words.enDefinition: a layer of epithelial cells covering the internal surface of a cavity or tube

examples.en: The epithelial lining forms a continuous border around the central space in the classroom image of the duct.
examples.zh: 课堂导管图中的「上皮衬层」在中央空隙周围形成连续边缘。

examples.en: We identified the epithelial lining by tracing the row of cells facing the open space in the section.
examples.zh: 我们沿切片中面向空隙的一排细胞追踪，从而辨认出「上皮衬层」。

words.enDefinition: the supporting cells and connective framework of an organ or tissue around its specialized structures

examples.en: The drawing shades the stroma around the glandular units to show the tissue that supports them.
examples.zh: 图中为腺体单位周围的「组织间质」涂上阴影，展示起支持作用的组织。

examples.en: We compared the denser stroma near the ducts with the regions occupied by specialized gland cells.
examples.zh: 我们对照了导管旁较致密的「组织间质」和特化腺细胞所在的区域。

words.enDefinition: the specialized tissue of an organ that carries out its characteristic functions

examples.en: The lesson labels the secretory units as parenchyma and the surrounding supporting tissue in a different color.
examples.zh: 课程图将分泌单位标为「实质组织」，把周围的支持组织标为另一颜色。

examples.en: We identified the parenchyma on the diagram by finding where the organ's characteristic cells were located.
examples.zh: 我们通过在图中找出器官特征性细胞的位置，辨认出「实质组织」。

words.enDefinition: a layer of dense connective tissue surrounding an organ or another anatomical structure

examples.en: The fibrous capsule appears as a compact outer band at the edge of the supplied organ section.
examples.zh: 在给出的器官切片边缘，「纤维被膜」呈致密的外侧带状结构。

examples.en: We traced the fibrous capsule around the classroom image before comparing it with the internal supporting tissue.
examples.zh: 我们先在课堂图上沿「纤维被膜」描出器官周边，再与内部支持组织作比较。

words.enDefinition: an internal connective partition separating parts or compartments of a tissue or organ

examples.en: A thin tissue septum separates two clusters in the low-power image provided for the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习给出的低倍图像中，一层薄「组织隔」将两簇结构分开。

examples.en: We followed the tissue septum from the outer covering toward the center of the illustrated gland.
examples.zh: 我们从外层被膜沿「组织隔」追踪至所绘腺体的中央。

words.enDefinition: a rounded group of secretory cells arranged around a small lumen in some glands

examples.en: The cross section shows a glandular acinus as a cluster of secretory cells around a tiny center.
examples.zh: 横切面显示，「腺泡」是一簇围绕微小中央腔排列的分泌细胞。

examples.en: We compared the rounded glandular acinus with the elongated duct profile beside it in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们将教学图中圆形的「腺泡」与邻近的长条形导管截面作比较。

words.enDefinition: a gland whose secretory portion forms an elongated tube, which can be straight, branched or coiled

examples.en: The tubular gland in the drawing has a long secretory part that extends below the tissue surface.
examples.zh: 图中「管状腺」的分泌部呈长条形，伸入组织表面以下。

examples.en: We followed the coiled portion of the tubular gland across several views in the teaching atlas.
examples.zh: 我们在教学图谱的几个视图中沿「管状腺」的盘曲部分追踪。

words.enDefinition: a conducting passage that carries a gland's secretion from its secretory units toward an outlet

examples.en: The atlas shows the excretory duct leading from the groups of secretory cells toward the epithelial surface.
examples.zh: 图谱显示，「排泄导管」从多个分泌细胞群通向上皮表面。

examples.en: We identified the excretory duct by tracing the continuous route away from the illustrated glandular clusters.
examples.zh: 我们沿一条连续路径从图示的腺体细胞簇向外追踪，辨认出「排泄导管」。

words.enDefinition: a feature introduced during specimen preparation, handling or imaging that does not reflect the original tissue

examples.en: The instructor labeled the unexpected line a histological artifact because it crossed several unrelated structures in the image.
examples.zh: 老师把图中穿过数处无关结构的异常线条标为「组织学伪影」。

examples.en: We annotated the histological artifact separately from the normal tissue structures in the slide reading exercise.
examples.zh: 在切片读图练习中，我们将「组织学伪影」与正常组织结构分开标注。

collocations: distinguish a histological artifact from tissue

words.enDefinition: an artifact where part of a tissue slice bends back or overlaps, often creating a darker region

examples.en: The section fold appeared as an unusually dark stripe where two layers overlapped in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 教学图中，两层重叠的位置出现一条异常深色的条纹，即「切片褶皱」。

examples.en: We marked the section fold before comparing the unobscured cells on either side in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们先标出「切片褶皱」，再比较其两边未被遮盖的细胞。

collocations: dark band from a section fold
area obscured by a section fold

words.enDefinition: a gap or split in a tissue slice caused by damage during preparation or handling

examples.en: The section tear cut across several structures and had uneven edges in the supplied classroom image.
examples.zh: 给出的课堂图中，「切片撕裂」横穿数处结构，边缘不规则。

examples.en: We compared the section tear with a true opening whose sides were lined by cells.
examples.zh: 我们对比「切片撕裂」与一个由细胞衬在两侧的真实开口。

collocations: image affected by a section tear

words.enDefinition: a rounded image feature caused by a trapped air bubble in or above a mounted specimen

examples.en: The circular air bubble artifact overlapped the tissue edge without belonging to the structure in the reference image.
examples.zh: 参考图中，圆形的「气泡伪影」与组织边缘重叠，实际并非该结构的一部分。

examples.en: We labeled the bright ring as an air bubble artifact on the classroom slide image.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂玻片图像上，将那道明亮的圆环标作「气泡伪影」。

collocations: outline of an air bubble artifact
view obstructed by an air bubble artifact

words.enDefinition: a portion of an image that appears blurred because features there lie outside the range of sharp focus

examples.en: The nuclei in the out-of-focus region were less sharply defined than the neighboring structures in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 教学图的「离焦区域」里，细胞核的轮廓不如相邻结构清晰。

examples.en: We excluded the out-of-focus region from a classroom comparison that required clearly visible details of cell boundaries.
examples.zh: 课堂比较需要清楚观察细胞边界细节，因此我们排除了「离焦区域」。

words.enDefinition: a labeled line on an image representing a known real distance

examples.en: We used the scale bar in the corner of the image to estimate the width of the gland.
examples.zh: 我们利用图像角落的「比例尺标线」估计腺体宽度。

examples.en: The enlarged image kept a scale bar so readers could compare real distances despite different displayed sizes.
examples.zh: 放大图保留了「比例尺标线」，让读者即使面对不同显示尺寸也能比较实际距离。

collocations: measure a feature using a scale bar

words.enDefinition: a selected microscope view that illustrates features typical of the tissue or category under discussion

examples.en: We chose a representative field showing the cell layers that were visible throughout the supplied teaching section.
examples.zh: 我们选取一个能显示整张教学切片上均可见细胞层的「代表性视野」。

examples.en: The instructor explained why one representative field could illustrate the arrangement but could not capture all variations.
examples.zh: 老师解释，单个「代表性视野」能够展示排列方式，但无法包含所有变异。

words.enDefinition: a reference collection of labeled images or diagrams of tissues and their microscopic structure

examples.en: We consulted the histology atlas to compare our teaching image with a labeled section of normal skin.
examples.zh: 我们查阅「组织学图谱」，将教学图像与有标注的正常皮肤切片作比较。

examples.en: The histology atlas shows the same tissue at two scales so students can move from layers to cells.
examples.zh: 「组织学图谱」用两个尺度展示同一组织，方便学生从组织分层转向细胞观察。

collocations: reference image in a histology atlas

words.enDefinition: the creation of images representing structures or functions inside the body using physical signals

examples.en: The introduction compares three kinds of medical imaging using labeled pictures from the anatomy teaching collection.
examples.zh: 导论使用解剖教学集中有标注的图片，比较三种「医学影像」方式。

examples.en: We used medical imaging examples to see how the same structure appears with different physical signals.
examples.zh: 我们用「医学影像」示例观察同一结构如何通过不同物理信号呈现。

words.enDefinition: a projection image produced by transmission of X-rays through the body, generally without added contrast material

examples.en: The plain radiograph shows several overlapping bones projected onto one flat image in the classroom atlas.
examples.zh: 课堂图谱中的「普通X线片」显示，多块相互重叠的骨被投射到同一平面图像上。

examples.en: We compared the plain radiograph with a cross-sectional image that separates structures at different depths.
examples.zh: 我们把「普通X线片」与一幅能分开显示不同深度结构的横断图作比较。

collocations: structure visible on a plain radiograph

words.enDefinition: a structure that attenuates X-rays relatively strongly and usually appears lighter on a conventional radiograph

examples.en: The atlas identifies dense bone as a radiopaque structure on the reference image printed for class.
examples.zh: 课堂参考图的图谱把致密骨标为「阻射结构」。

examples.en: We compared the light area of the radiopaque structure with the darker region containing air in the model.
examples.zh: 我们将「阻射结构」的浅色区与模型中包含空气的较暗区域比较。

words.enDefinition: an area transmitting relatively more X-rays and usually appearing darker on a conventional radiographic display

examples.en: The radiolucent region looked dark because the air in that part of the model transmitted more X-rays.
examples.zh: 「X线透亮区」呈暗色，因为模型该部分的空气让更多 X 线穿过。

examples.en: We labeled the radiolucent region separately from the lighter bone outlines on the classroom reference print.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂参考印图上，将「X线透亮区」和颜色较浅的骨轮廓分别标记。

words.enDefinition: the orientation of the X-ray beam through the body relative to the image detector

examples.en: The radiographic projection affects which structures overlap in the two illustrated views of the anatomy model.
examples.zh: 「X线投照方向」会影响解剖模型两个示意视图中哪些结构发生重叠。

examples.en: We read an arrow on the reference diagram to determine the radiographic projection used for the example.
examples.zh: 我们读取参考图上的箭头，判断示例采用的「X线投照方向」。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray projection in which the beam passes through the body from front to back

examples.en: The arrow for the anteroposterior projection enters the front of the torso outline on the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂图上，「前后位投照」的箭头从躯干轮廓前侧进入。

examples.en: We checked the label of the anteroposterior projection before comparing it with the reverse beam direction.
examples.zh: 在与相反射线方向作比较前，我们先核对「前后位投照」的标记。

collocations: compare anteroposterior projection with posteroanterior projection

words.enDefinition: an X-ray projection in which the beam passes through the body from back to front

examples.en: The posteroanterior projection diagram shows the beam entering the posterior side of the classroom torso model.
examples.zh: 「后前位投照」图显示，射线从课堂躯干模型的后侧进入。

examples.en: We located the detector on the anterior side of the posteroanterior projection illustration in the handout.
examples.zh: 我们在讲义的「后前位投照」图中，于前侧找到探测器。

words.enDefinition: an X-ray projection image made with the beam directed through the body from one side toward the other

examples.en: The lateral radiograph shows the curved outlines from the side in the teaching example of the skull.
examples.zh: 在颅骨教学示例中，「侧位X线片」从侧面显示弧形轮廓。

examples.en: We compared the lateral radiograph with the front view to localize the outlined object in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们对照「侧位X线片」和正面图，判断课堂模型中圈出物体的位置。

words.enDefinition: X-ray imaging that displays a continuing series of projection images to show movement over time

examples.en: The fluoroscopy example shows the outline changing position across successive frames of the teaching video.
examples.zh: 教学视频的「X线透视」示例显示，轮廓在连续帧中改变位置。

examples.en: We distinguished fluoroscopy from a single static radiograph by looking at how the lecture displayed movement.
examples.zh: 我们通过观察课件如何显示运动，区分「X线透视」与单张静态 X 线片。

words.enDefinition: a method that reconstructs cross-sectional images from X-ray measurements taken at many angles

examples.en: The classroom example uses computed tomography to display a stack of slices through the same anatomical model.
examples.zh: 课堂示例用「计算机断层成像」显示穿过同一解剖模型的一组切层。

examples.en: We compared computed tomography with a projection image to see how deeper structures are separated in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们对照「计算机断层成像」与投影图，观察图中怎样将深处的结构区分开。

words.enDefinition: a cross-sectional image representing one reconstructed layer of a computed tomography volume

examples.en: The uppermost CT slice in the teaching stack shows a different outline than the section immediately beneath it.
examples.zh: 教学图组的最上方「CT层面图」显示的轮廓与紧邻下方的层面不同。

examples.en: We followed the same labeled structure from one CT slice to the next in the supplied anatomy example.
examples.zh: 我们在给定解剖示例中，从一张「CT层面图」追踪同一标注结构到下一张。

words.enDefinition: in CT, the reconstructed measure of how strongly material in a region reduces transmitted X-ray intensity

examples.en: The teaching diagram displays different CT attenuation values for air and bone in the same reconstructed image.
examples.zh: 教学图在同一幅重建图像中为气体和骨显示不同的「CT衰减值」。

examples.en: We compared the CT attenuation of two labeled regions using the values provided beside the image.
examples.zh: 我们用图像旁给出的数值比较两个标注区域的「CT衰减值」。

words.enDefinition: a unit on the standardized CT attenuation scale that assigns zero to water and approximately minus one thousand to air

examples.en: The example CT display reports estimated attenuation in each selected region using the Hounsfield unit scale.
examples.zh: 示例 CT 显示用「亨斯菲尔德单位」量表报告各选区估计的衰减值。

examples.en: We read the Hounsfield unit label next to the attenuation values listed for the teaching scan.
examples.zh: 我们读取教学扫描中所列衰减数值旁的「亨斯菲尔德单位」标签。

words.enDefinition: the range of CT attenuation values, centered on a chosen window level, mapped across the available display shades

examples.en: Changing the CT window made subtle shades easier to distinguish within the soft tissue in the example.
examples.zh: 更改「CT显示窗」后，示例中软组织内的细微灰度差异更容易辨认。

examples.en: We compared two CT window settings on the same slice to see which shades became easier to separate.
examples.zh: 我们比较同一层面的两种「CT显示窗」设置，观察哪些灰度更容易区分。

words.enDefinition: a CT display setting that emphasizes attenuation differences among soft tissues

examples.en: The soft-tissue window made neighboring soft tissue regions easier to distinguish on the classroom display.
examples.zh: 课堂展示中，「软组织窗」使相邻软组织区域更易辨认。

examples.en: We compared the soft-tissue window with another display made from the same reconstructed scan in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们把「软组织窗」与同一重建扫描的另一种显示作对照。

collocations: image shown in a soft-tissue window

words.enDefinition: a CT display setting that emphasizes differences in attenuation within and around bone

examples.en: The bone window showed fine differences in the light bone region on the supplied classroom image.
examples.zh: 在给出的课堂图像上，「骨窗」显示出较亮骨区里的细微差异。

examples.en: We used the bone window example to distinguish display settings from changes to the underlying scan itself.
examples.zh: 我们用「骨窗」示例区分显示设置变化与原有扫描数据本身的变化。

collocations: image shown in a bone window

words.enDefinition: the creation of views in selected planes from existing three-dimensional imaging data

examples.en: The display uses multiplanar reconstruction to show three perpendicular views of the same dataset on one screen.
examples.zh: 显示界面使用「多平面重建」，在一个屏幕上展示同一数据集的三个正交视图。

examples.en: We recognized multiplanar reconstruction when the highlighted position appeared in two perpendicular views of the teaching model.
examples.zh: 高亮位置出现在教学模型的两个正交视图中时，我们认出了「多平面重建」。

words.enDefinition: imaging that uses magnetic fields and radiofrequency signals from atomic nuclei, usually hydrogen, to construct images

examples.en: The lecture describes magnetic resonance imaging with a diagram showing how tissue signals contribute to an image.
examples.zh: 讲义用示意图介绍「磁共振成像」，展示组织信号怎样参与形成图像。

examples.en: We compared two magnetic resonance imaging examples with different contrast patterns on the anatomy course page.
examples.zh: 我们比较了解剖学课程页上显示不同对比模式的两幅「磁共振成像」示例。

collocations: tissue contrast in magnetic resonance imaging

words.enDefinition: an MRI image whose contrast is designed to emphasize differences in longitudinal relaxation time

examples.en: The instructor placed a T1-weighted image beside another view to compare how the regions appeared at different intensities.
examples.zh: 老师将一张「T1加权图像」放在另一视图旁，对照各区域呈现的不同信号强度。

examples.en: We read the label identifying a T1-weighted image before comparing the fluid spaces in the two examples.
examples.zh: 我们先读出标明「T1加权图像」的标签，再比较两个示例中的含液空间。

words.enDefinition: an MRI image whose contrast is designed to emphasize differences in transverse relaxation time

examples.en: The T2-weighted image shows a brighter fluid space than the neighboring tissue in the selected teaching example.
examples.zh: 在选定的教学示例中，「T2加权图像」里的含液空间比相邻组织亮。

examples.en: We compared a T2-weighted image with a different image of the same plane in the classroom atlas.
examples.zh: 我们将「T2加权图像」与课堂图谱中同一平面的另一幅图像作比较。

words.enDefinition: the value of the reconstructed MRI signal at an image location under stated acquisition settings

examples.en: The instructor asked us to compare signal intensity between adjacent structures within the same teaching image.
examples.zh: 老师让我们在同一张教学图像中比较相邻结构的「信号强度」。

examples.en: We compared relative signal intensity within each displayed sequence using nearby tissue as a reference.
examples.zh: 我们以邻近组织为参照，在各序列内部比较相对「信号强度」。

words.enDefinition: an area of an MRI image that has higher signal intensity than a stated surrounding or reference tissue

examples.en: The hyperintense region appears brighter than the surrounding tissue in this displayed teaching image.
examples.zh: 在这张展示的教学图像中，「高信号区」显得比周围组织更亮。

examples.en: We described the hyperintense region relative to the neighboring tissue shown on the same sequence.
examples.zh: 我们参照同一序列图像上显示的相邻组织，描述「高信号区」。

collocations: relative brightness of a hyperintense region
hyperintense region on a weighted image

words.enDefinition: an area of an MRI image that has lower signal intensity than a stated surrounding or reference tissue

examples.en: The hypointense region looked darker than the adjacent structure on the classroom reference image.
examples.zh: 在课堂参考图上，「低信号区」显得比邻近结构更暗。

examples.en: We labeled the hypointense region along the tissue border and recorded which sequence produced the image.
examples.zh: 我们标出组织边界处的「低信号区」，并记录产生图像的序列。

collocations: relative darkness of a hypointense region
hypointense region on a weighted image

words.enDefinition: imaging that uses echoes of high-frequency sound waves to represent structures or motion

examples.en: The ultrasonography diagram traces the returning echoes and shows how they contribute to the displayed teaching image.
examples.zh: 「超声成像」示意图追踪返回的回声，展示它们如何参与形成教学显示图像。

examples.en: We compared ultrasonography with radiography by identifying the different physical signal that each method uses.
examples.zh: 我们通过辨认两种方法使用的不同物理信号，比较「超声成像」与 X 线成像。

words.enDefinition: a component that converts electrical signals to sound pulses and returning echoes back into electrical signals

examples.en: The ultrasound transducer is the labeled component sending pulses into the illustrated classroom model.
examples.zh: 「超声换能器」是图中标明的、向课堂模型发出脉冲的部件。

examples.en: We followed the two arrows showing outgoing pulses and incoming echoes at the ultrasound transducer.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「超声换能器」处表示外发脉冲与返回回声的两个箭头追踪。

collocations: echo received by an ultrasound transducer

words.enDefinition: a two-dimensional ultrasound view in which brightness represents the processed strength of returning echoes

examples.en: The B-mode ultrasound image displays relatively strong echoes as bright marks in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的「B型超声图像」用亮点显示较强的回声。

examples.en: We compared the two dimensions shown in a B-mode ultrasound image with the underlying classroom anatomical drawing.
examples.zh: 我们对照「B型超声图像」所显示的二维截面与对应的课堂解剖图。

B-mode ultrasound image of a section

words.enDefinition: the tendency of a structure to produce returning ultrasound echoes, often described relative to nearby tissue

examples.en: The teaching example compares the echogenicity of two structures that appear at similar depths in the image.
examples.zh: 教学示例比较图中处于相近深度的两个结构的「回声性」。

examples.en: We described the echogenicity relative to the nearby tissue rather than assigning a fixed brightness to the structure.
examples.zh: 我们参照邻近组织描述「回声性」，而没有为该结构指定固定亮度。

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound region showing no detectable internal echoes under the stated imaging conditions

examples.en: The anechoic region appeared dark within the simple fluid model shown on the teaching page.
examples.zh: 在教学页所示的简单含液模型内部，「无回声区」呈暗色。

examples.en: We distinguished the anechoic region from a nearby area that still showed some faint internal echoes.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「无回声区」和邻近仍显示微弱内部回声的区域。

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound region producing stronger echoes and usually appearing brighter than the chosen reference tissue

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows the hyperechoic region as brighter than the surrounding reference tissue on the display.
examples.zh: 课堂图的显示界面中，「高回声区」比周围作为参照的组织更亮。

examples.en: We marked the hyperechoic region after comparing its echoes with those from the adjacent structure in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们对照它与邻近结构的回声后，标出了「高回声区」。

collocations: relative brightness of a hyperechoic region

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound region producing weaker echoes and usually appearing darker than the chosen reference tissue

examples.en: The hypoechoic region had faint echoes and looked darker than the adjacent brighter tissue in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，「低回声区」的回声微弱，显得比相邻的较亮组织暗。

examples.en: We labeled the hypoechoic region using neighboring tissue as a brightness reference on the classroom display.
examples.zh: 我们以课堂显示中相邻组织的亮度为参照，标出了「低回声区」。

collocations: relative brightness of a hypoechoic region

words.enDefinition: a region of reduced ultrasound echoes behind a structure that strongly attenuates or reflects the sound beam

examples.en: The image shows an acoustic shadow extending deep to the bright modeled object in the classroom display.
examples.zh: 课堂显示的图像上，「声影」从明亮模型物体的深面延展开来。

examples.en: We distinguished the acoustic shadow from the object that blocked much of the sound reaching the deeper region.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「声影」与阻止多数声波到达深部区域的物体。

words.enDefinition: an ultrasound method that uses frequency shifts of echoes from moving structures to depict or estimate motion

examples.en: The Doppler ultrasound example shows a classroom model of blood flow with colors defined by its display legend.
examples.zh: 「多普勒超声」示例以课堂血流模型展示流动情况，颜色含义由显示图例给出。

examples.en: We read the scale before comparing opposite directions of movement in the Doppler ultrasound simulation.
examples.zh: 我们先读比例标尺，再对照「多普勒超声」模拟中相反方向的运动。

words.enDefinition: a letter or symbol showing how an image corresponds to an anatomical side or direction

examples.en: We checked the anatomical orientation marker before identifying the right side on the reversed-looking anatomy image.
examples.zh: 我们在外观似乎左右相反的解剖图上辨认右侧前，先核对「解剖方位标记」。

examples.en: One anatomical orientation marker indicated the front of the body in the classroom example of a cross section.
examples.zh: 在课堂横切面示例中，有一个「解剖方位标记」指明人体前方。

collocations: position of an anatomical orientation marker

words.enDefinition: the extent of a selected or reconstructed imaging slice in the direction perpendicular to its plane

examples.en: The metadata lists slice thickness alongside the orientation for each view of the teaching scan in class.
examples.zh: 课堂教学扫描的元数据在各视图的方位旁列出「层厚」。

examples.en: We compared slice thickness with the distance between adjacent slice centers, which differed in one example.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「层厚」和相邻层面中心之间的距离，两者在一个示例中并不相同。

words.enDefinition: a three-dimensional volume element represented by one value in a digital image dataset

examples.en: Each image voxel has a width, height and depth in the classroom diagram of reconstructed anatomy data.
examples.zh: 课堂解剖数据重建图中，每个「影像体素」都有宽、高和深度。

examples.en: We compared the displayed pixel with the corresponding image voxel that also represented depth in the dataset.
examples.zh: 我们将显示的像素与相应「影像体素」对照，后者在数据中也表示深度。

words.enDefinition: the skin and associated structures such as hair, nails and cutaneous glands

examples.en: The integumentary system diagram groups the skin with hair, nails and the glands in the skin.
examples.zh: 「皮肤系统」图将皮肤与毛发、指甲和皮肤内的腺体归在一起。

examples.en: We used the integumentary system model to locate several structures that reach the outer surface in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用「皮肤系统」模型找出几种延伸到外表面的结构。

words.enDefinition: the outer epithelial layer of the skin

examples.en: In the sectioned model, the epidermis forms the thin layer above the vascular connective tissue of the skin.
examples.zh: 在剖开的模型中，「表皮」形成皮肤内有血管结缔组织上方的一层薄层。

examples.en: We followed the epidermis across the reference image where the outer surface had several shallow folds.
examples.zh: 在外表面有几处浅褶皱的参考图上，我们沿「表皮」追踪其走向。

words.enDefinition: the connective tissue layer beneath the epidermis that contains vessels, nerves and many skin appendages

examples.en: The dermis contains the labeled vessels and hair structures in the enlarged normal skin image.
examples.zh: 放大的正常皮肤图中，标出的小血管与毛发结构位于「真皮」内。

examples.en: We compared the thickness of the dermis with the thinner epithelial layer above it in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型上，我们对照「真皮」厚度与其上较薄的上皮层厚度。

words.enDefinition: the layer beneath the dermis containing loose connective tissue and often varying amounts of fat

examples.en: The skin model shows the hypodermis as a lighter region with clusters of fat cells below the dermis.
examples.zh: 皮肤模型将「皮下组织」画成真皮下方较浅的区域，里面有成簇脂肪细胞。

examples.en: We drew the boundary of the hypodermis distinctly below the main skin layers in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中，将「皮下组织」边界清楚地画在皮肤主要层次下方。

words.enDefinition: the superficial dermal layer of loose connective tissue that interlocks with the epidermis

examples.en: The papillary dermis is the loose connective tissue immediately below the epidermis in our prepared slide.
examples.zh: 在这张制好的切片中，「真皮乳头层」是紧邻表皮下方的疏松结缔组织。

examples.en: We identified the papillary dermis by its proximity to the epidermis in the labeled skin section.
examples.zh: 我们根据它紧邻表皮这一点，在有标注的皮肤切片中辨认出「真皮乳头层」。

collocations: connective tissue of the papillary dermis

words.enDefinition: the deeper dermal layer, largely made of dense irregular connective tissue with thick fiber bundles

examples.en: The reticular dermis shows thicker bundles of fibers than the superficial region in the classroom section.
examples.zh: 在课堂切片中，「真皮网状层」里的纤维束比浅层区域的更粗。

examples.en: We labeled the reticular dermis beneath the superficial layer and above the subcutaneous fat in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中，于表浅层下方和皮下脂肪上方标出「真皮网状层」。

words.enDefinition: a small projection of superficial dermal connective tissue into the overlying epidermal region

examples.en: One dermal papilla appears as an upward projection at the boundary in the enlarged skin drawing.
examples.zh: 在放大的皮肤图上，一处「真皮乳头」表现为边界上朝上的突起。

examples.en: We traced the edge of a dermal papilla to distinguish its tissue from the surrounding epithelial cells.
examples.zh: 我们沿一处「真皮乳头」边缘辨认，将该处组织与周围的上皮细胞区分开。

words.enDefinition: a downward projection of epidermis into the dermis between adjacent dermal papillae

examples.en: We marked the rete ridge extending downward between two dermal projections in the classroom section of skin.
examples.zh: 在课堂皮肤切片图上，我们标出向下伸入两个真皮突起之间的「表皮突」。

examples.en: We traced the sides of a rete ridge where it joined surrounding epidermis on the enlarged image.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的图上沿一处「表皮突」与周围表皮相连的两侧辨认其轮廓。

words.enDefinition: the main cell type of the epidermis, which forms keratin and contributes to the outer skin barrier

examples.en: We labeled a keratinocyte in the body of the epidermal layer on the enlarged classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的课堂图上，在表皮层内部标出一个「角质形成细胞」。

examples.en: The diagram shows how the shape of a keratinocyte changes as it approaches the outer surface.
examples.zh: 图中显示，「角质形成细胞」逐渐靠近外表面时，其形状如何改变。

words.enDefinition: a pigment-producing cell that makes melanin and transfers it to nearby keratinocytes in skin

examples.en: The drawing places a melanocyte near the base of the epidermis with processes reaching toward neighboring cells.
examples.zh: 图中，一个「黑素细胞」位于表皮底部附近，突起伸向邻近细胞。

examples.en: We used the arrows to trace pigment transfer from the melanocyte on the classroom model of skin.
examples.zh: 我们利用箭头，在课堂皮肤模型上追踪从「黑素细胞」向外转移的色素。

words.enDefinition: the deepest layer of the epidermis adjacent to the basement membrane

examples.en: The stratum basale appears as the deepest row of epidermal cells in the labeled classroom skin section.
examples.zh: 在有标注的课堂皮肤切片中，「基底层」是最深的一排表皮细胞。

examples.en: We identified the stratum basale between the basement membrane and the thicker layer just above it.
examples.zh: 我们在基底膜与其上较厚的一层之间辨认出「基底层」。

words.enDefinition: the epidermal layer above the basal layer, characterized in many sections by cells with spiny-looking outlines

examples.en: The classroom image labels the stratum spinosum above the single deeper row in the epidermis of the skin.
examples.zh: 课堂图在皮肤表皮中较深的单排细胞上方标出「棘层」。

examples.en: We compared cell shapes in the stratum spinosum with those in the flatter layer above it.
examples.zh: 我们将「棘层」细胞与上方一层较扁平的细胞作形状对照。

words.enDefinition: an epidermal layer containing flattened cells with prominent keratohyalin granules

examples.en: On the enlarged thick skin slide, the stratum granulosum lies immediately beneath the clear layer.
examples.zh: 在放大的厚皮肤切片中，「颗粒层」紧邻透明层下方。

examples.en: We marked the dark granules within cells of the stratum granulosum on the stained classroom reference image.
examples.zh: 我们在染色的课堂参考图中，标记「颗粒层」细胞内的深色颗粒。

words.enDefinition: a thin clear epidermal layer between the granular and outer layers in thick skin, such as palms and soles

examples.en: The stratum lucidum appears as a pale strip below the outermost layer in the thick skin teaching example.
examples.zh: 在课堂厚皮肤示例中，「透明层」呈最外层下方的一道浅色细带。

examples.en: We looked for the stratum lucidum only on the thick skin image when comparing the two reference sections.
examples.zh: 对照两张参考切片时，我们只在厚皮肤图像上寻找「透明层」。

words.enDefinition: the outermost epidermal layer made of flattened dead cells that help form the skin's barrier

examples.en: The stratum corneum forms the laminated outer covering in the reference image of skin used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂所用皮肤参考图中的「角质层」是呈叠层状的外部覆盖层。

examples.en: We compared the stratum corneum in two anatomical regions and noted the difference in its thickness.
examples.zh: 我们对照两个解剖区域的「角质层」，记录其厚度差异。

collocations: skin barrier of the stratum corneum

words.enDefinition: a tubular structure derived from the epidermis that surrounds the hair root and supports hair growth

examples.en: The hair follicle extends from a narrow opening at the skin surface down into the classroom cross section.
examples.zh: 课堂横切图中，「毛囊」从皮肤表面的狭窄开口向下延伸。

examples.en: We traced the hair follicle along the sides of the developing hair in the enlarged skin model.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的皮肤模型中，沿生长中毛发的两侧描出「毛囊」。

words.enDefinition: the portion of a hair projecting beyond the skin surface

examples.en: The hair shaft is visible above the surface in the labeled diagram of the intact skin model.
examples.zh: 在完整皮肤模型的标注图中，表面以上可以看到「毛干」。

examples.en: We compared the external hair shaft with the portion remaining below the surface in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 在教学图上，我们对照外露的「毛干」与仍在皮肤表面以下的部分。

words.enDefinition: the portion of a hair located below the skin surface and enclosed within the follicle

examples.en: The model shows the hair root inside the follicle before the hair emerges at the surface.
examples.zh: 模型显示，毛发尚未露出皮肤表面的部分「毛根」位于毛囊内部。

examples.en: We traced the hair root toward its expanded base on the enlarged section through the follicle.
examples.zh: 我们在穿过毛囊的放大切面上，沿「毛根」追踪至其膨大的底部。

words.enDefinition: the enlarged base of a hair root containing cells that contribute to hair growth

examples.en: The diagram marks the hair bulb as the enlargement of the hair root at the follicle's base.
examples.zh: 图中将毛囊底部膨大的毛根标为「毛球」。

examples.en: We identified the hair bulb as the base below the narrower root in the teaching image.
examples.zh: 我们在教学图像中辨认出较细毛根下方的膨大底部，即「毛球」。

words.enDefinition: the population of actively dividing cells in the hair bulb that gives rise to growing hair

examples.en: The sketch places the hair matrix near the base of the bulb in the classroom hair growth model.
examples.zh: 课堂毛发生长模型的示意图中，「毛母质」位于毛球基部附近。

examples.en: We labeled the hair matrix where the diagram shows new cells joining the forming hair structure.
examples.zh: 我们在图示新细胞进入正在形成的毛发结构处标出「毛母质」。

words.enDefinition: a small band of smooth muscle attached to a hair follicle whose contraction raises the hair

examples.en: We identified the arrector pili muscle as a slanted band linking the follicle to superficial dermis in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将连接毛囊与浅层真皮的一束斜走结构标为「竖毛肌」。

examples.en: The animation shows how contraction of an arrector pili muscle changes the angle of the modeled hair.
examples.zh: 动画显示，一处「竖毛肌」收缩时，模型中毛发的角度怎样改变。

collocations: attach to an arrector pili muscle

words.enDefinition: a skin gland that secretes an oily substance, usually into a hair follicle

examples.en: The sebaceous gland appears as rounded clusters connected to the hair follicle on the class reference section.
examples.zh: 课堂参考切片中，「皮脂腺」呈与毛囊相连的圆形细胞簇。

examples.en: We followed the short opening from the sebaceous gland into the follicle drawn on the skin model.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「皮脂腺」通入皮肤模型所画毛囊的短通道追踪。

words.enDefinition: the oily mixture secreted by sebaceous glands onto the skin or into hair follicles

examples.en: The arrows in the diagram show sebum passing from its gland into the channel around the hair.
examples.zh: 图中箭头表示，「皮脂」从其腺体流入毛发周围的通道。

examples.en: We identified sebum as the oily secretion pictured beside the gland in the classroom model of skin.
examples.zh: 在课堂皮肤模型上，我们将腺体旁所示的油性分泌物标为「皮脂」。

words.enDefinition: a coiled sweat gland whose duct usually opens directly onto the skin surface and supports cooling

examples.en: The eccrine sweat gland has a duct reaching the surface without entering the nearby follicle in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「小汗腺」有一条到达皮肤表面的导管，未通入附近毛囊。

examples.en: We located the coiled part of the eccrine sweat gland deep in the skin on the teaching section.
examples.zh: 我们在教学切片的皮肤深处找到了「小汗腺」的盘曲部分。

collocations: secretion from an eccrine sweat gland

words.enDefinition: a skin gland in certain body regions that generally opens into a hair follicle

examples.en: In the underarm skin diagram, the apocrine sweat gland empties into a hair follicle through its duct.
examples.zh: 腋窝皮肤图中，「大汗腺」经导管开口于毛囊。

examples.en: We compared the location of the apocrine sweat gland opening with the one reaching the skin surface directly.
examples.zh: 我们比较了「大汗腺」开口位置与直接到达皮肤表面的另一处开口位置。

collocations: opening of an apocrine sweat gland

words.enDefinition: the passage that carries the secretion of a sweat gland toward its outlet

examples.en: The sweat duct winds upward through the skin layers on the enlarged reference drawing used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的放大参考图中，「汗腺导管」蜿蜒向上穿过各皮肤层。

examples.en: We traced the sweat duct separately from the deeper coiled secretory portion on the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型上，将「汗腺导管」与较深的盘曲分泌部区分并分别追踪。

collocations: sweat passing through a sweat duct

words.enDefinition: the hard keratin structure forming the visible main part of a fingernail or toenail

examples.en: The nail plate is the rigid structure on top of the fingertip in the classroom sectioned model.
examples.zh: 课堂指尖切面模型上，「甲板」是指尖上方的硬质结构。

examples.en: We shaded the nail plate separately from the living skin immediately beneath it in the teaching diagram.
examples.zh: 在教学图中，我们给「甲板」与紧靠它下方的活性皮肤组织分别着色。

collocations: free edge of the nail plate

words.enDefinition: the growth region beneath the proximal nail fold that produces most of the nail plate

examples.en: The nail matrix is drawn beneath the proximal skin fold in the enlarged finger model used in class.
examples.zh: 课堂使用的放大手指模型中，「甲母质」画在近端的皮肤皱襞下方。

examples.en: We labeled the nail matrix where the diagram shows material forming at the back of the nail.
examples.zh: 我们在图中指甲后部有新物质形成的位置标出了「甲母质」。

collocations: nail plate produced by the nail matrix

words.enDefinition: the tissue directly under the nail plate that supports it along most of its length

examples.en: The nail bed appears as a narrow strip under the rigid plate on the classroom finger model.
examples.zh: 课堂手指模型上，「甲床」位于坚硬的甲板下，呈狭长条状。

examples.en: We traced the nail bed underneath the visible portion of the nail in the side-view reference diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在侧视参考图上，沿指甲可见部分下方追踪「甲床」。

words.enDefinition: the protective interface of the skin, especially the outer epidermis, that limits water loss and entry of external substances

examples.en: The model illustrates the cutaneous barrier as a continuous outer layer separating internal tissues from the environment.
examples.zh: 模型把「皮肤屏障」画成分隔内部组织和外部环境的一层连续外层。

examples.en: We used the cutaneous barrier diagram to explain why layers of flattened epidermal cells are important.
examples.zh: 我们用「皮肤屏障」图解释扁平表皮细胞构成的层为什么重要。

collocations: outer layer of the cutaneous barrier
